title: Payments Service — Stripe Webhook Endpoint
description:
Implement dedicated POST /webhooks/stripe endpoint with HMAC signature verification. This endpoint bypasses the IP-based rate limiter (NEX-231) and instead validates authenticity via Stripe's webhook signature.

Approach approved by Priya Sharma in email_12. Option 2 selected (HMAC verification vs IP whitelist) for superior security.

Implementation:
- Verify Stripe-Signature header using stripe.webhooks.constructEvent()
- Handle events: payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed, charge.refunded
- Write all events to payment_audit_log (NEX-219)
- Return 200 immediately, process asynchronously via Bull queue

PR #56 in progress.
